mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, generates short-term optimism in equities, pushing the S&P 500 forward return positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, no statistically significant positive return (p > 0.05) when HOUST shows upward momentum.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment, measured by PAYEMS, reduces labor market uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In regimes with high unemployment, the same signal produces non-significant or negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises by more than 0.25% in a month, the S&P 500 60-day forward return tends to be negative due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% in a single month
failure_condition: No significant negative return (p > 0.05) during identified rate hikes in non-recessionary economies.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening supply-side constraints, which historically precedes a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: Repeated INDPRO contractions without any positive 5-day forward return (rolling IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) trigger preemptive equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant negative return (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL rises but economic growth remains robust.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (PAYEMS) accompanied by rising wage growth (implied via UNRATE) creates a dual labor market signal that is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases by > 2% in a month and UNRATE increases by > 0.1% in the same month
failure_condition: No significant positive return (p > 0.05) when both signals occur in a recessionary environment.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained period of falling short-term rates (FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 20-day forward return exhibits a positive trend, as lower borrowing costs enhance equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: No positive return trend (rolling IC < 0.01) during the rate-cutting period when other risk factors are neutral.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) followed by a rebound in 1 month (triggered by a regime shift) signals improving supply conditions and is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for 2 months then rises in the third month
failure_condition: No significant positive return (p > 0.05) when the rebound occurs during a global recession.
